description: In Queens, New York, there is a house with the same address as the home of Peter Parker, aka Spider-Man, in the Marvel comic books. Since the 1990s, the Forest Hills home gets hundreds of letters from across the country and around the globe from places like Thailand, India, and Switzerland. Now, the house is for sale for $2.1 million and whoever buys it will receive all that fan mail.
title: NYC Home With Spider-Man's Address, Which Gets Hundreds of Fan Letters, Hits the Market
